Card Q&A.q: I activated this card's inherited effect and placed the top Digimon card of that Digimon as the bottom digivolution card. At such times, if that Digimon's top card becomes this card itself, does its [Your Turn] effect trigger?

Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When effects place Digimon cards with the [CS] trait in this Digimon's digivolution cards, if you have 1 or fewer Tamers, you may play 1 Tamer card with the [CS] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [Main] [Once Per Turn] By placing this [CS] trait Digimon's top stacked card as its bottom digivolution card, ＜Draw 1＞.
